local.about: Launch pricing (Adham, 2026-10-15): a buyer in Saudi Arabia, the UAE or Egypt is quoted and charged in their own currency, with VAT ADDED on top of the package's local price: total = net + VAT, shown as "price + VAT = total". packages[].prices.<CUR> and extra_platform_prices.<CUR> are the NET prices before VAT. VAT = net x vat_pct / 100, rounded half-up to 0.01 on the whole order (base + extra platforms). The country comes from the client (SA / AE / EG only, never typed free text); any other country pays the USD price above with no VAT. Read by mena-batch/app/core/local-price.mjs (engine, portal), the Launchpad's pricing.py (checkout, a byte-for-byte copy of this file) and the site's data/pricing.json (republished from this file). vat_registration: PLACEHOLDER, Adham supplies each country's VAT / tax registration number before it is printed or sent to Stripe; null = not registered yet, nothing is printed.

packages.name: Brand Deck
packages.coming_soon_why: Brand Deck is shown as coming soon and is never payable: checkout, quotes, Payment Links, Mark paid and packageFromPayment all refuse it (Adham, 2026-10-14)

rules.per_platform_items_why: platform content is made per platform (a full adaptation, never a resize): a Keep Growing client on 2 platforms gets posts 20 + 20; every other item is per client
